name: pool-maintenance
//: The budget of this repository's declared pool maintenance (onevcs.toml, the justfile's pool-maintenance recipe): budgets.yaml, the measure.sh it runs, and install-pruner.sh, which `just bootstrap` runs to install the pinned pruner. Its one budget is labelled host, so it runs in the repo-uniform budgets-host target; measure.sh builds the workspace twice, so check and the affected run select only `-t budgets`, never budgets-host, and `just budgets-host` (which ci.yml's release-PR sweep runs) is the one recipe that reaches it. The gate tiers reach only its format, lint and test; its test is offline (stand-in tools, nothing built), and the journey that drives real cargo and the real pruner is pool-maintenance-host's. It depends on nothing.

options.command: bash tools/coverage/shcov.sh run pool-maintenance -- bun test pool-maintenance/tests

test.//: Offline journeys with stand-in tools: install-pruner.sh as just bootstrap drives it (installs the pin once, replaces an off-pin pruner, and its failures), and measure.sh's refusals before anything builds.
